'''Paul Gabriel García Oviedo''' (born 2 October 1990) is a Peruvian lawyer, businessman and politician. He was a [[Congress of the Republic of Peru|Congressman]], representing [[Callao]] from 16 March 2020 to 26 July 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Congresistas por Región|url=http://www.congreso.gob.pe/CongresistasRegion/|access-date=2021-05-16|website=www.congreso.gob.pe}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
García was born on 2 October 1990. He completed his primary and secondary studies in the city of [[Lima]] and in 2012 studied technical marketing at the Zegel IPAE school. He began law studies at the [[Pontifical Catholic University of Peru|Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú]], obtaining a bachelor's degree in law and the professional title of lawyer.<ref name="sunedu">{{Cite web|title=Registro Nacional de Grados y Títulos|url=https://enlinea.sunedu.gob.pe/|publisher=Superintendencia Nacional de Educación Superior Universitaria (SUNEDU)|access-date=28 July 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Hoja de Vida del Candidato|url=https://infogob.jne.gob.pe/Politico/FichaPolitico/paul-gabriel-garcia-oviedo_historial-partidario_IWUnlM518k4c6+@0ElOxMA==UM|publisher=Infogob|date=2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}</ref>

From 2014 he was a student leader at the Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú, arriving at the Federated Center of Law and the University Assembly of the PUCP.{{citation needed|date=August 2022}}

He later obtained a master's degree in Political Science and Public Management from [[Rey Juan Carlos University]] in Spain,<ref name="sunedu" /> and a master's degree in Strategic Business Administration from the [[Universidad Nacional del Callao|National University of Callao]], registered with the National Registry of Academic Degrees and Professional Titles of SUNEDU.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Registro Nacional de Grados Académicos y Títulos Profesionales|url=https://enlinea.sunedu.gob.pe/|publisher=Superintendencia Nacional de Educación Superior Universitaria (SUNEDU)|access-date=11 August 2026|quote=García Oviedo, Paul Gabriel, DNI 46645685 — Maestro en Administración Estratégica de Empresas, Universidad Nacional del Callao, fecha de diploma 17/06/2026}}</ref> He is currently pursuing a doctorate in Public Policy and State Management at the [[Centro de Altos Estudios Nacionales]] (CAEN).<ref>{{Cite web|title=¿Quién soy?|url=https://paulgarciaoviedo.com/acerca-de-pagina/|website=Official website of Paul García Oviedo|access-date=12 August 2026}}</ref> He is admitted to practice law with the Lima Bar Association (Ilustre Colegio de Abogados de Lima, CAL), registration No. 97956.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Búsqueda de Agremiados|url=https://servicioscal.org.pe/consulta_habilidad/result|publisher=Ilustre Colegio de Abogados de Lima (CAL)|access-date=28 July 2026}}</ref>

== Career ==
García is affiliated with the [[Popular Action (Peru)|Popular Action]] party.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Paul García Oviedo - Historial Partidario|url=https://infogob.jne.gob.pe/Politico/FichaPolitico/paul-gabriel-garcia-oviedo_historial-partidario_IWUnlM518k4c6+@0ElOxMA==UM|publisher=Infogob|access-date=5 April 2020}}</ref> He was also a candidate for the Callao provincial mayor's office during the [[2018 Peruvian regional and municipal elections|2018 municipal elections]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://elcomercio.pe/lima/sucesos/elecciones-2018-conoce-candidatos-callao-planes-gobierno-noticia-564540-noticia/|access-date=2021-05-16|title=Elecciones 2018: conozca a los candidatos del Callao y sus planes de gobierno|website=El Comercio Perú|language=es}}</ref> He also served as National Executive Director of the Association of Municipalities of Peru (AMPE).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Paul García Oviedo|url=https://infogob.jne.gob.pe/Politico/FichaPolitico/paul-gabriel-garcia-oviedo_procesos-electorales_IWUnlM518k4c6+@0ElOxMA==UM|publisher=Infogob|access-date=5 April 2020}}</ref>

During the [[2020 Peruvian parliamentary election|extraordinary elections of 2020]], he was elected a congressman of the republic on behalf of the [[Constitutional Province of Callao]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Mag|first=Redacción|date=2020-02-08|title=Resultados Elecciones 2020: ¿quiénes son los nuevos congresistas peruanos?|url=https://mag.elcomercio.pe/mag/resultados-elecciones-2020-onpe-quienes-son-los-nuevos-congresistas-nnda-nnlt-noticia/|access-date=2021-05-16|website=Mag.|language=es}}</ref> García was in favor of the [[Removal of Martín Vizcarra|removal of President Martín Vizcarra]] during the two processes that took place for it, the second of which ended up removing the former president from power. The congressman supported the motion, being one of the 105 parliamentarians who voted in favor of the removal of President Martín Vizcarra.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Los 105 congresistas que votaron a favor de la vacancia de Vizcarra|url=https://canaln.pe/actualidad/vacancia-vizcarra-105-congresistas-votaron-favor-n427599|date=15 November 2020|publisher=Canal N|access-date=2021-05-16|language=es}}</ref>

He is the founding managing partner ("socio director") of the law firm García Oviedo Abogados y Consultores.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Inicio|url=https://garciaoviedoabogados.com/|website=García Oviedo Abogados y Consultores|access-date=12 August 2026}}</ref>

== Controversies ==
In October 2023, a party held in his honor, attended by his partner, congresswoman Rosselli Amuruz, ended in a shooting and one fatality.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Saavedra|first=Narda|date=2023-10-01|title=Fiesta a la que asistió congresista Rosselli Amuruz termina con balacera y 1 fallecido|url=https://larepublica.pe/politica/2023/10/01/fiesta-de-congresista-rosselli-amuruz-termina-con-balacera-y-1-fallecido-69596|website=larepublica.pe|language=es|access-date=2023-10-02}}</ref>

'''Tabatha Robinson''' (born February 28, 1992),<ref name="Birthday"/> known professionally as '''DreamDoll''', is an American rapper. She appeared on season 16 of [[Oxygen (TV channel)|Oxygen]]'s ''[[Bad Girls Club: Social Disruption]]'', and in 2017, she joined the cast of [[VH1]]'s ''[[Love & Hip Hop: New York]]''. In 2022, she joined the [[BET+]] series ''[[College Hill: Celebrity Edition]]'', and two years later, she became a main cast member on VH1's ''[[The Impact: New York]]''.

As a recording artist, she signed with [[Warner Records]] in 2021.

== Early life ==
Robinson was born on February 28, 1992<ref name="Birthday"/> and raised in [[Edenwald Houses|Edenwald Projects]], in the [[Eastchester, Bronx|Eastchester]] neighborhood in the Bronx, New York.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dreamdoll – NY DJ Con |url=https://nydjcon.com/speaker/theoriginaldreamdoll/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |language=en-US}}</ref> Robinson attended Bronx Academy High School. Later on, she joined Westchester College and Herkimer Community College. She is the oldest of 5 siblings with 2 sisters & 2 brothers.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=@Longemag |title=Business {{!}} Fashion {{!}} Entertainment {{!}} Marketing {{!}} Music Promotions - Dream Doll |url=https://www.longemagazine.com/entertainmentnews/item/364-dream-doll.html |access-date=2023-05-07 |website=Business {{!}} Fashion {{!}} Entertainment {{!}} Marketing {{!}} Music Promotions |date=22 May 2018 |language=en-gb}}</ref>

In 2015, she began working as a bartender at popular New York strip club, Starlets. DreamDoll quickly became a favoured bartender at Starlets widely known as one of their ‘Startenders’. This helped her gain a following on social media, she would primarily be known for her pictures on [[Instagram]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Marie |first=Erika |date=2021-11-17 |title=DreamDoll Details Reality TV Origins, Transition To Rap, Coming Out As Bisexual & More |url=https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/385696-dreamdoll-details-reality-tv-origins-transition-to-rap-coming-out-as-bisexual-and-more-news |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=HotNewHipHop |language=en-US}}</ref> In September 2016, DreamDoll became a cast member on season 16 of the Reality TV Show, [[Bad Girls Club: Social Disruption|Bad Girls Club]] and the following year she was signed to DJ Self's record label, Gwinnin Entertainment.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dream Doll Announces That She's Signed To Warner Records |url=https://theshaderoom.com/dream-doll-announces-that-shes-signed-to-warner-records/ |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=theshaderoom.com|date=12 August 2021 }}</ref>

== Career ==
On May 16, 2017, she released her debut single titled Everything Nice.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Entertainment |first=Bong Mines |date=2017-09-19 |title=DreamDoll releases a music video for her "Everything Nice" single |url=https://www.bongminesentertainment.com/dreamdoll-everything-nice/ |access-date=2023-05-07 |website=Bong Mines Entertainment |language=en-US}}</ref> On September 5, 2017, DreamDoll released the official music video for Everything Nice the video has since gained over 8 million views.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ju |first=Shirley |date=2022-11-03 |title=Dreamdoll Talks 'Life In Plastic 3', Fashion, Workout Regime & More! |url=http://www.sheenmagazine.com/dreamdoll-talks-life-in-plastic-3-fashion-workout-regime-more/ |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=Sheen Magazine |language=en-US}}</ref> On September 20, 2017, DreamDoll released her first mixtape titled Life In Plastic. The mixtape featured 14 tracks, 7 which were released exclusively on [[SoundCloud]]. In October, 2017 DreamDoll joined the cast of [[Love & Hip Hop: New York]] [[Love & Hip Hop: New York season 8|season 8]].<ref>{{Citation |title=Safaree Aims High For His Date With Dreamdoll - Love & Hip Hop New York {{!}} VH1 |date=2017-11-07 |url=https://www.vh1.com/video-clips/gbznia/love-hip-hop-new-york-safaree-aims-high-for-his-date-with-dreamdoll |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210923111820/https://www.vh1.com/video-clips/gbznia/love-hip-hop-new-york-safaree-aims-high-for-his-date-with-dreamdoll |url-status=live |archive-date=September 23, 2021 |access-date=2023-05-07 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Who Is Dream Doll, Barbie Looking 'Bad Girl' on Love & Hip Hop? |url=https://2paragraphs.com/2017/10/who-is-dream-doll-barbie-looking-bad-girl-on-love-hip-hop/ |access-date=2023-05-07 |website=2paragraphs.com |language=en-US}}</ref>  Before the end of the year she released 3 more videos for songs off her Life In Plastic Mixtape; Team Dream, We All Love Dream & Ice Cream.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Inman |first=DeMicia |date=2022-05-26 |title=DreamDoll Serves Up Her Favorite Flavors In "Ice Cream Dream" Music Video Featuring French Montana |url=https://www.vibe.com/music/videos/dreamdoll-french-montana-ice-cream-dream-video-1234664593/ |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=VIBE.com |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2017, DreamDoll became a brand ambassador for fashion brand [[Fashion Nova]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=DreamDoll Spotted on Set Wearing Fashion Nova Orange Cropped Puffer Jacket – Fashion Bomb Daily |url=https://fashionbombdaily.com/dreamdoll-spotted-on-set-wearing-fashion-nova-orange-cropped-puffer-jacket/ |access-date=2024-07-03 |website=fashionbombdaily.com|date=10 January 2022 }}</ref>

On June 22, 2018, DreamDoll released a new single titled 'Pull Up (WYA)'. The accompanying music video was released in August 2018. The same month appeared as a team captain on [[MTV]]’s [[Wild 'n Out]].<ref>{{Citation |title=DreamDoll - "Ah Ah Ah" - Nick Cannon Presents: Wild 'N Out {{!}} VH1 |date=2022-03-09 |url=https://www.vh1.com/video-clips/loubf4/nick-cannon-presents-wild-n-out-dreamdoll-ah-ah-ah |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220317020345/https://www.vh1.com/video-clips/loubf4/nick-cannon-presents-wild-n-out-dreamdoll-ah-ah-ah |url-status=live |archive-date=March 17, 2022 |access-date=2023-05-17 |language=en}}</ref> In July, 2018 DreamDoll became an ambassador for fashion brand [[PrettyLittleThing]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Seen On PLT Influencers {{!}} The 411 {{!}} PLT |url=https://blog.prettylittlething.com/seen-on-plt-influencers-10/ |access-date=2024-07-03 |website=blog.prettylittlething.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Seen On PLT Influencers {{!}} The 411 {{!}} PLT |url=https://blog.prettylittlething.com/seen-on-plt-influencers-177/ |access-date=2024-07-03 |website=blog.prettylittlething.com}}</ref>

On September 7, 2018, DreamDoll released her second mixtape titled Life In Plastic:2. The 10 song mixtape featured [[Lil' Kim]], LouGotCash, [[Cupcakke]] & David Lee. On September 10, 2018, DreamDoll had her first headlining concert celebrating the release of her mixtape, the same day she released the music video for the second single from the mixtape 'Bundles'.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Burks |first=Tosten |date=2018-09-11 |title=DreamDoll 'Life in Plastic 2' EP: New Music with Lil Kim and More - XXL |url=https://www.xxlmag.com/dreamdoll-life-in-plastic-2-tracklist-lil-kim-cupcakke/ |access-date=2024-07-03 |website=XXL Mag |language=en}}</ref>

In January 2019, DreamDoll's name got brought up during a rap feud between [[Tory Lanez]] & [[Don Q]]. After hearing this DreamDoll went on to release a diss track aimed at [[Tory Lanez]] titled 'On Ya Head'. The song was an instant hit and quickly garnered a lot of attention as DreamDoll had introduced her new flow some refer to as her 'nightmare flow'. The same day the track was released, her second mixtape Life In Plastic:2 reentered the [[iTunes]] Hip Hop & Rap charts and peaked at #2. In March she featured on [[Vado (rapper)|Vado]]'s song 'Talk To Me', a music video was also released. On May 22, 2019, she released the third and final music video from Life In Plastic: 2 for 'When It's Over'(A music video was shot for 'Real One' however the footage was lost). In August, 2019 DreamDoll appeared on two episodes of [[VH1]]'s [[Hip Hop Squares]].

=== RCA Records (2019–2021) ===
In Early 2019, DreamDoll signed a joint record deal with [[RCA Records]] & Brooklyn Johnny's District 18 Entertainment.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2018-11-15 |title=Brooklyn Johnny Partners With RCA Records for New Label, District 18 |url=https://variety.com/2018/biz/news/brooklyn-johnny-partners-with-rca-district-18-1203029273/ |access-date=2024-07-03 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref> She was later featured on [[Hitmaka]]'s 'Thot Box Remix' alongside [[Young MA]], [[Dreezy]], [[Latto]] & Chinese Kitty.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hitmaka Enlists Young M.A, Dreezy, Mulatto, and More for "Thot Box (Remix)" Video |url=https://www.complex.com/music/2019/11/hitmaka-young-ma-dreezy-mulatto-thot-box-remix |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=Complex |language=en}}</ref> It was released with an accompanying music video. The song was an instant hit and DreamDoll's verse garnered the attention of many listeners. Later on, in November 2019 she released her 'Behind Bars' Freestyle.<ref>{{Cite web |last=WWETV-admin |date=2019-11-26 |title=DreamDoll – Behind Bars Freestyle |url=https://www.worldwideentertainmenttv.com/dreamdoll-behind-bars-freestyle/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |language=en-US |archive-date=2023-05-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230520144456/https://www.worldwideentertainmenttv.com/dreamdoll-behind-bars-freestyle/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> It is a remix of [[Drake (musician)|Drake]]'s Behind Barz Freestyle.

DreamDoll |url=https://dirty-glove.net/watch-bandhunta-izzy-vibes-feat-dreamdoll/ |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=Dirty Glove Bastard |language=en}}</ref> The following month she was featured on DJ Drewski's song 'Water' alongside [[Rubi Rose]] & Molly Brazy. On July 10, 2020 DreamDoll released a single, "[[Ah Ah Ah (song)|Ah Ah Ah]]" featuring [[Fivio Foreign]]. The song was released with accompanying merch & a lyric video. On November 13, 2020 G4 Boyz released 'Prada Remix' featuring DreamDoll & G4Choppa an accompanying music video was also released.<ref>{{Cite web |title=New York's G4 Boyz Release Hit Single Remix 'Prada' Featuring DreamDoll and G4Choppa |url=https://www.exclusiveaudio.net/blog/g4boyz |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=Exclusive Audio |language=en-US}}</ref> On December 17, 2020 DreamDoll & LightSkinKeisha were featured on [[Saucy Santana]]'s 'It's a Vibe', which also released with an accompanying music video.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Saucy Santana - It's a Vibe (feat. DreamDoll & LightSkinKeisha) |url=http://globalmedialine.com/mv/saucy-santana-it-s-a-vibe-feat-dreamdoll-lightskinkeisha/index.php |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=globalmedialine.com}}</ref>

=== Warner Records (2021–present) ===
On August 11, 2021, it was officially announced that DreamDoll had signed a record deal with [[Warner Records]].<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Berry |first=Peter A. |date=2021-11-19 |title=With a New Record Deal on Her Lap, DreamDoll Wants to Elevate Even More |url=https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/dream-doll-warner-records-interview-1235000362/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |magazine=Billboard |language=en-US}}</ref> She also signed with WME Agency. On August 24, 2021, DreamDoll performed on the Main Stage at [[Hot 97]] Summer Jam.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Staff |first=Hot 97 |date=2022-05-02 |title=Ah Ah AH: DreamDoll Returns To Hot 97 Summer Jam Stage |url=https://www.hot97.com/events/ah-ah-ah-dream-doll-returns-to-hot-97-summer-jam-stage |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=Hot 97 |language=en-US}}</ref>

On November 24, 2021, DreamDoll released her debut single under [[Warner Records]] titled 'You Know My Body' featuring [[Capella Grey]]. The song samples 'Can't Let Go' by [[Fabolous]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=DreamDoll and Capella Grey link up for "You Know My Body" visual |url=https://www.revolt.tv/article/2021-11-24/127756/dreamdoll-and-capella-grey-link-up-for-you-know-my-body-visual/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=REVOLT |language=en-US}}</ref> She later released an accompanying music video for the song. On November 19, 2021, DreamDoll's song 'Chacin' was released on the soundtrack for [[Halle Berry]]'s [[Netflix]] movie [[Bruised (film)|Bruised]]. The soundtrack was created by [[Halle Berry]] & [[Cardi B]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Inman |first=DeMicia |date=2021-11-19 |title=Women Rappers On Halle Berry's 'Bruised' Soundtrack Speak On Excitement For The Album |url=https://www.vibe.com/news/entertainment/halle-berry-bruised-soundtrack-1234637191/ |access-date=2023-05-07 |website=VIBE.com |language=en-US}}</ref>  On December 9, 2021, she featured on [[Rick Ross]]' song 'Wiggle', the song released with an accompanying music video.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Mier |first=Tomás |date=2022-01-13 |title=Watch Rick Ross 'Wiggle' With DreamDoll in New Video |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/rick-ross-dreamdoll-wiggle-video-1284551/ |access-date=2023-05-21 |magazine=Rolling Stone |language=en-US}}</ref> On December 17, 2021, DreamDoll released 'Oh Shhh'. The song was used as the theme song for the final season of [[Claws (TV series)|Claws]], the song was released with an accompanying music video featuring the cast members of [[Claws (TV series)|Claws]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Major |first=Michael |title=VIDEO: DreamDoll Shares CLAWS-Themed Single 'Oh Shhh' |url=https://www.broadwayworld.com/bwwmusic/article/VIDEO-DreamDoll-Shares-CLAWS-Themed-Single-Oh-Shhh-20211217 |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=BroadwayWorld.com |language=en}}</ref>

In February 2022, DreamDoll appeared on Kendy X's 'For Me Remix' alongside [[Kalan.FrFr]]. She also featured on Loui's 'Get In Get Out', both songs released with music videos. On March 8, 2022, DreamDoll made her second appearance on [[MTV]]'s [[Wild 'n Out]] as a team captain. On April 22, 2022, DreamDoll released a single titled 'Ice Cream Dream' featuring [[French Montana]], a music video was also released. On May 6, 2022, DreamDoll began touring with [[Fivio Foreign]] the tour consisted of 19 shows and ended on June 6, 2022. On May 13, 2022, DreamDoll was featured on [[King Combs]]'s 'Gas You Up'. On June 27, 2022, DreamDoll joined the cast of the [[BET+]] series [[College Hill: Celebrity Edition]] Season 1.

On September 22, 2022, DreamDoll released the third and final instalment of her Life In Plastic series, 'Life In Plastic:3'. The 8 track EP featured 5 new songs and 3 pre released singles.<ref>{{Cite web |title=DreamDoll Releases 'Life in Plastic 3' Project f/ French Montana, LunchMoney Lewis, and Capella Grey |url=https://www.complex.com/music/dreamdoll-life-in-plastic-3-stream |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=Complex |language=en}}</ref> The same day, she released the official music video for 'Misunderstood'.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-02-21 |title=DreamDoll Is 'Misunderstood,' But Her Catchy Rap Lyrics Should Be |url=https://uproxx.com/music/dreamdoll-misunderstood-rap-lyrics/ |access-date=2023-05-21 |website=UPROXX |language=en-US}}</ref> The EP included her single 'Fantasy' featuring [[Kash Doll]], and a music video was set to be shot but they never began filming for unknown reasons.<ref>{{Cite web |title=DreamDoll returns with new 'Life In Plastic 3' mixtape |url=https://www.revolt.tv/article/2022-09-27/212990/dreamdoll-life-in-plastic-3-mixtape/ |access-date=2023-05-07 |website=REVOLT |language=en-US}}</ref> It was rumored that [[Bia (rapper)|Bia]] was to feature on 'Fantasy'. On September 27, 2022, she performed at [[Rolling Loud]], New York. In October, 2022 [[BET+]] released a new reality TV series '[[The Impact: Atlanta]]', DreamDoll made a few guest appearances.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Davis |first=J. R. |date=2022-10-05 |title=DreamDoll "You Have To Have A Strong Mind For Reality TV' |url=https://blackamericaweb.com/2022/10/05/dream-doll-bad-girls-club-love-and-hip-hop-the-impact-atlanta/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=Black America Web |language=en-US}}</ref>

On February 24, 2023 [[Russ Millions]] released "Habibti" featuring DreamDoll & [[French Montana]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=kodecx |date=2023-05-15 |title=Russ Millions, French Montana, DreamDoll - Habibti MP3 Download {{!}} Kodecx |url=https://basenaija.com/download/russ-millions-french-montana-dreamdoll-habibti/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |language=en-US |archive-date=2023-05-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517191646/https://basenaija.com/download/russ-millions-french-montana-dreamdoll-habibti/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> On April 20, 2023, DreamDoll played the role of Meena in the [[MTV]] stoner movie ''Pretty Stoned''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=McNamara |first=Bre |title=Kandi Burruss, Brandee Evans, Porsha Williams, DreamDoll, Pretty Vee And More Star In MTV Comedy Film 'Pretty Stoned' |url=https://shadowandact.com/kandi-burruss-brandee-evans-porsha-williams-dreamdoll-pretty-vee-and-more-star-in-mtv-comedy-film-pretty-stoned |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=Shadow and Act |language=en}}</ref> On July 6, 2023, DreamDoll released her '[[Red Bull]] 60 Seconds' freestyle via Instagram. The same month DreamDoll released two more songs with accompanying music videos, titled "I'll Be Good (Freestyle)" and "Project Dick". On August 3, 2023, DreamDoll released the music video for "Frank Stand" from her EP ''Life In Plastic:3''. In December 2023, DreamDoll was featured on the cover of Viper Magazine's 10th anniversary issue.<ref name="attacktheculture.com">{{Cite web |date=2023-12-04 |title=DreamDoll: The New York rap diva flexing on the new 'VIPER' magazine cover is a huge must-see |url=https://www.attacktheculture.com/news/dreamdoll-the-new-york-rap-diva-flexing-on-the-new-viper-magazine-cover-is-a-huge-must-see |access-date=2024-01-24 |website=Attack The Culture |language=en-US}}</ref>

On December 22, 2023, it was announced that DreamDoll would be a main cast member on [[VH1]] & [[BET+]]'s reality TV series ''[[The Impact: New York]]'', which premiered on [[VH1]] on January 22, 2024.<ref name="attacktheculture.com"/> On March 8, 2024, DreamDoll released her single Jelly. The remix to Jelly featuring [[2Rare]] was dropped on May 10, alongside the music video.

In July 2026, DreamDoll participated as a student in the second installment of [[Kai Cenat]]'s [[Streamer University]] creator bootcamp, marking an expansion of her digital presence into the live-streaming space.<ref>{{cite web |date=July 6, 2026 |title=PlaqueBoyMax, T-Pain and DreamDoll Bring Their Streaming Talents to Kai Cenat's Streamer University 2026 |url=https://www.xxlmag.com/t-pain-dreamdoll-kai-cenat-streamer-university-2026/ |website=XXL Mag}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Approved |first=Sammy |date=July 19, 2026 |title=9 Black Women Enrolled In Kai Cenat's Streamer University |url=https://madamenoire.com/1681927/black-women-kai-cenat-streamer-university/ |website=MadameNoire}}</ref> During the multi-day broadcast, she became the subject of widespread online attention following a highly publicized on-stream dispute involving fellow student [[Queen Naija]]. The confrontation occurred after Queen Naija's partner, Clarence White, was seen visiting the dorm room that DreamDoll shared with content creator Jordyn Lucas.<ref>{{cite web |date=July 18, 2026 |title=Messy Boots? Queen Naija's Ex Chris Sails Shoots His Shot At DreamDoll After Clarence Chills In Her Dorm (VIDEOS) |url=https://wdkx.com/messy-boots-queen-naijas-ex-chris-sails-shoots-his-shot-at-dreamdoll-after-clarence-chills-in-her-dorm-videos/ |website=WDKX}}</ref>

'''Álvaro Sebastián Pillado Irribarra''' ([[Concepción, Chile|Concepción]], September 24, 1986) is a Chilean lawyer and politician, member of the [[Independent Democratic Union]] (UDI). He served as Undersecretary of National Assets and Director of the [[Division of Social Organizations]] (DOS) in the second term of President [[Sebastián Piñera|Sebastián Piñera Echenique]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2019-11-19 |title=Álvaro Pillado asume como subsecretario de Bienes Nacionales |url=https://www.bienesnacionales.cl/?p=36525 |access-date=2024-02-27 |website=Ministerio de Bienes Nacionales |language=es-CL}}</ref>

== Public life ==
He was national youth president of the [[Independent Democratic Union]] (UDI) party.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2011-04-05 |title=Álvaro Pillado asumió como el nuevo Presidente Nacional de la Juventud UDI |url=https://www.soychile.cl/Concepcion/Sociedad/2011/04/05/6505/Alvaro-Pillado-asumio-como-el-nuevo-Presidente-Nacional-de-la-Juventud-UDI.aspx |access-date=2024-02-27 |website=SoyChile |language=Spanish}}</ref> In 2011, he was selected as one of Chile's "100 young leaders" by El Sábado magazine of the [[El Mercurio]] newspaper.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Álvaro Pillado : Red de Líderes Jóvenes |url=https://www.redlideres.cl/lider/alvaro-pillado/ |access-date=2024-02-27 |website=www.redlideres.cl}}</ref> During the first term of [[Sebastián Piñera]]'s presidency, he served as the deputy national director of the [[National Youth Institute (Chile)|National Youth Institute]] (INJUV) and later as a legislative adviser in the [[Senate of Chile|Senate]].<ref>{{Cite web |date= |title=Álvaro Pillado |url=http://www.bienesnacionales.cl/?page_id=1692 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200202020255/http://www.bienesnacionales.cl/?page_id=1692 |archive-date=2020-02-02 |access-date=2024-02-27 |website=}}</ref>

From 2018 to 2019, he worked as the director of the Division of Social Organizations (DOS) at the [[Ministry General Secretariat of Government (Chile)|General Secretariat of Government]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |title=Seremi que no pudo asumir en el Biobío será director de la División Organizaciones Sociales |url=https://cooperativa.cl/noticias/pais/gobierno/seremi-que-no-pudo-asumir-en-el-biobio-sera-director-de-la-division/2018-04-01/234114.html |access-date=2024-02-27 |website=Cooperativa.cl |language=Spanish}}</ref> On November 11, 2019, he was appointed as the Undersecretary of National Assets by President Sebastián Piñera Echenique.<ref name=":0" />

'''Tigarah''' ({{Langx|ja|ティガラ}}) is a Japanese house and dance music DJ and producer.<ref>{{cite news |title=ティガラ、ＡＩ業績予測サービス提供へ ウェブ情報から分析 |url=https://www.nikkan.co.jp/articles/view/00459921?gnr_footer=0011570 |work=日刊工業新聞電子版 |publisher=[[Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun]]}}</ref> She studied politics at [[Keio University]] in Tokyo. Early in her career, she was the first Japanese [[Funk carioca|Baile Funk]] rapper. She is now is a house and dance music producer based in [[Paris]], [[France]].<ref>{{cite news |title=BIOGRAPHY - UNIVERSAL MUSIC JAPAN |url=https://www.universal-music.co.jp/tigarah/biography/ |work=[[Universal Music Japan]] |language=ja}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Music & Nightlife in San Jose, CA {{!}} Music {{!}} Tigarah |url=https://www.metroactive.com/metro/04.12.06/tigarah-0615.html |work=metroactive.com |publisher=[[Metro Silicon Valley]]}}</ref>

Tigarah's time in LA, along with her first EP, created a buzz which landed her "It-girl" status in the global market. Her features in publications such as ''[[Los Angeles Times]]'', ''[[Dazed|Dazed & Confused]]'', ''[[Rolling Stone]]'', [[VH1]] and many more, leading to four of her songs being used for [[EA Sports]], ''[[FIFA 08|FIFA 2008]]'' & ''[[FIFA 09|2009]]'', ''[[FaceBreaker]]'' and ''[[Need for Speed: Carbon]]''.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Sachs |first1=Rob |title=Tigarah: Japanese Rap with a Brazilian Accent |url=https://www.npr.org/2006/06/22/5503937/tigarah-japanese-rap-with-a-brazilian-accent |work=npr.org}}</ref>

Tigarah has released two albums: ''The Funkeira goes GANG!'' (2010) and ''This World Is My Playground'' (2015) from [[Universal Music Japan]]. In 2016, her track with Lewis Cancut "Say OK featuring Tigarah" working with NLV Records in Australia, as well as her collaboration with British rock band [[Keane (band)|Keane]] for their EP ''Night Train'' the cover track of YMO "You’ve got to help yourself" amplified her brand with her tracks being played on [[Diplo]] and [[Skrillex]]'s Radio.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Robson |first1=Daniel |title=Tigarah 'The Funkeira goes BANG!' |url=https://www.japantimes.co.jp/culture/2009/09/04/music/cd-reviews/tigarah-the-funkeira-goes-bang/ |work=[[The Japan Times]] |date=4 September 2009 |language=en}}</ref>

Tigarah was the face of [[Proactiv]] from 2016 to 2017. She wrote for ''[[Cosmopolitan (magazine)|Cosmopolitan Japan]]'' and ''[[Elle (magazine)|ELLE girl]]''. She has also been the face of [[E!|E! Entertainment]] Japan since 2016.<ref>{{cite news |title=外務省を目指していた慶応ガールがブラジルにいったワケ |url=https://www.cosmopolitan.com/jp/trends/lifestyle/interviews/a1458/living-your-own-life-in-tokyo-tigarah/ |work=[[Cosmopolitan (magazine)|Cosmopolitan]] |date=20 May 2016 |language=ja-JP}}</ref>

She moved to Paris in 2019 and focused on her DJ career signing with [[RCA Records|RCA]], [[Sony Music|Sony France]]. Her single "Je t’emmène au vent feat. Lea Paci" made a buzz on radio and was on Hits Français. Her music video has almost 2 million views.<ref>{{cite news |title=Tigarah changes name for new project, releases "Spunky Afro Tiger Jet" |url=https://aramajapan.com/news/musicvideo/tigarah-changes-name-for-new-project-releases-spunky-afro-tiger-jet/10748/ |work=ARAMA! JAPAN |date=3 October 2014}}</ref>

Political analyst and contributor for [[CNN]] | net_worth = | boards = | spouse = | children = | parents = }} '''Astead Wesley Herndon''' (born March 31, 1993)@AsteadWH (March 31, 2026). [https://x.com/AsteadWH/status/2039003390273880329 "Today is my birthday. I am 33 years old"]. ''[[X (social network)|X.com]]''. is an American journalist. Since October 2025, he hosts a podcast and directs political coverage at [[Vox (website)|''Vox'']]. He was previously a reporter for ''[[The New York Times]],'' where he covered politics and hosted the podcast ''The Run-Up''.{{cite web |last=McGlothian |first=Elise |date= 26 February 2021|title=The Nontraditional Route: In Conversation with Astead Herndon |url=https://minervastrategies.com/astead-herndon/ |access-date=March 6, 2025 |publisher=Minerva Strategies |archive-date=March 18, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250318050654/https://minervastrategies.com/astead-herndon/ |url-status=live }}{{cite web |last1=Garrett |first1=Brianne |last2=Shapiro |first2=Ariel |last3=Cuccinello |first3=Hayley |last4=Knight |first4=Brett |date= |title=Forbes 30 Under 30 - Media |url=https://www.forbes.com/30-under-30/2021/media/ |access-date=March 6, 2025 |work=Forbes |archive-date=December 1, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201201131606/https://www.forbes.com/30-under-30/2021/media/ |url-status=live }} He has also contributed to [[CNN]] and reported for the ''[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]'' and ''[[The Boston Globe]]''. ==Early life and education== Herndon was born on March 31, 1993, in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], and raised in the suburb of [[Flossmoor, Illinois|Flossmoor]].{{cite web|url=https://resources.depaul.edu/newsroom/news/press-releases/Pages/cjie-awards-2025.aspx|title=Astead Herndon of The New York Times to receive award from DePaul University|last=|first=|publisher=DePaul Newsroom|date=January 30, 2025|access-date=March 6, 2025|archive-date=January 30, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250130192317/https://resources.depaul.edu/newsroom/news/press-releases/Pages/cjie-awards-2025.aspx|url-status=live}} His father established a branch of the [[Church of God in Christ]].{{cite web|url=https://faithandleadership.com/episode-2-astead-herndon-navigating-the-career-pipeline-young-black-newspaper-reporter|title=Episode 2: Astead Herndon on navigating the career pipeline as a young, black newspaper reporter|last1=Everett|first1=Laura|last2=Lamar|first2=Bill|publisher=Faith & Leadership, Duke Divinity|date=January 23, 2018|access-date=March 6, 2025|archive-date=November 14, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241114173641/https://faithandleadership.com/episode-2-astead-herndon-navigating-the-career-pipeline-young-black-newspaper-reporter|url-status=live}} He graduated from [[Homewood-Flossmoor High School]] in 2010.{{Cite news|url=https://www.hfchronicle.com/2018/04/24/ny-times-reporter-shares-insights-h-fs-journalism-class|title=NY Times reporter shares insights with H-F's journalism class|first=Marilyn|last=Thomas|date=April 24, 2018|newspaper=H-F Chronicle|archive-date=October 8, 2025|access-date=March 12, 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251008154956/https://www.hfchronicle.com/2018/04/24/ny-times-reporter-shares-insights-h-fs-journalism-class/|url-status=live}} He later graduated from [[Marquette University]] with a degree in journalism.{{cite web|url=https://www.nytco.com/press/astead-herndon-joining-the-times/|title=Astead Herndon Joining The Times|last=|first=|work=The New York Times|date=April 6, 2018|access-date=March 6, 2025|archive-date=February 18, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218063547/https://www.nytco.com/press/astead-herndon-joining-the-times/|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=https://www.ppic.org/person/astead-herndon/|title=Astead Herndon|last=|first=|publisher=Public Policy Institute of California|date=|access-date=March 6, 2025|archive-date=May 19, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250519020204/https://www.ppic.org/person/astead-herndon/|url-status=live}} While there, he became involved with the [[National Association of Black Journalists]] (NABJ). He worked with [[AmeriCorps]] during a gap year while at Marquette. == Career == Herndon worked as a journalist with the ''[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]'' and later in [[Washington D.C.]] as part of the [[White House press corps]]. After interning at ''The Boston Globe'', Herndon became a reporter there in 2015, where he worked as part of their Metro and City Hall sections. Among his pieces while at the Globe included uncovering real estate fraud in the [[Boston]] area, as well as turning down a $5,000 bribe and uncovering the source of the bribe in a two-part story. He joined ''The New York Times'' in 2018. He has extensively covered national elections with the newspaper, starting with the [[2018 United States elections|2018 midterm elections]]. In 2019, he was the newspaper's reporter for [[Kamala Harris]]' [[Kamala Harris 2020 presidential campaign|2020 presidential campaign]]. His coverage of the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]] was included as part of ''The New York Times'' nomination for the [[Pulitzer Prize]] in 2021.{{cite web|url=https://politics.uchicago.edu/fellows/former-fellows/astead-herndon|title=Astead Herndon - Institute of Politics|last=|first=|publisher=The University of Chicago Institute of Politics|date=|access-date=March 6, 2025}} His 2024 profile of Kamala Harris was nominated for a [[National Magazine Award]].{{cite web|url=https://www.houseofspeakeasy.org/astead-herndon/|title=Astead W. Herndon - House of SpeakEasy NYC|last=|first=|publisher=House of SpeakEasy|date=|access-date=March 6, 2025|archive-date=January 20, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250120132753/https://www.houseofspeakeasy.org/astead-herndon/|url-status=live}} Herndon hosted ''The Run-Up'', a podcast created in 2022 and dedicated to election coverage and politics more broadly. It was named one of the best podcasts of 2022 by ''[[The Economist]]''. The podcast was also nominated for the [[Toner Prize for Excellence in Political Reporting]] and a [[Livingston Award]]. In 2021, he was named a member of [[Forbes 30 Under 30]] in the Media category. In 2023, he was named a Pritzker fellow at the [[University of Chicago Institute of Politics]] for their Winter-Spring 2023 cohort. Herndon was awarded with the Distinguished Journalist Award by [[DePaul University]]'s Center for Journalism Integrity & Excellence in 2025. In October 2025, Herndon left the ''Times'' to host a podcast for ''Vox'' and serve as editorial director of its political coverage.{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2025-10-16 |title=Astead W. Herndon Joins Vox as Host and Editorial Director |url=https://www.vox.com/press-room/464712/astead-herndon-joins-vox |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Vox |language=en-US |archive-date=2025-11-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251113194354/https://www.vox.com/press-room/464712/astead-herndon-joins-vox |url-status=live }} Herndon also works as a political analyst and contributor for CNN. ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.nytimes.com/by/astead-w-herndon#about Herndon's page on ''The New York Times''] *[https://www.nytimes.com/column/election-run-up-podcast The Run Up's page on ''The New York Times''] {{wikiquote}} {{Authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Herndon, Astead}} [[Category:1993 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:People from Flossmoor, Illinois]] [[Category:African-American journalists]] [[Category:Members of the Church of God in Christ]] [[Category:Journalists from Illinois]] [[Category:21st-century American journalists]] [[Category:The New York Times journalists]] [[Category:The Boston Globe people]] [[Category:Milwaukee Journal Sentinel people]] [[Category:CNN people]] [[Category:Marquette University alumni]] [[Category:University of Chicago fellows]] [[Category:Vox (website) people]] [[Category:White House correspondents]]

'''Giovanni Guida''' (born 12 October 1992) is an Italian painter, known for his contemporary approach to the surrealist techniques of [[grattage]] and [[Rubbing (art)|frottage]].

==Biography==
Born in [[Acerra]], Italy in 1992 and raised in [[Cesa]] (province of Caserta), Guida studied at the "[[Luca Giordano]]" art high school  in [[Aversa]] and subsequently obtained his bachelor's and master's degrees in [[painting]] from the [[Accademia di Belle Arti di Napoli|Academy of Fine Arts]] in [[Naples]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Dartford |first=Katy |title=Surrealism at 100: Giovanni Guida explores hidden depths with innovative grattage |url=https://www.euronews.com/culture/2024/06/13/surrealism-at-100-giovanni-guida-explores-hidden-depths-with-innovative-grattage |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[Euronews]] |date=13 June 2024 }}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Gural |first=Natasha |title=Italian Artist Giovanni Guida Embraces Max Ernst's Groundbreaking Techniques To Create Narratives Straddling The Holy And The Secular |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/natashagural/2021/10/21/italian-artist-giovanni-guida-embraces-max-ernsts-groundbreaking-techniques-to-create-narratives-straddling-the-holy-and-the-secular/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[Forbes]]}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=Grajales |first=Manuel |title=Giovanni Guida, el artista italiano heredero del surrealismo |url=https://forbes.com.mx/forbes-life/cultura-giovanni-guida-el-artista-italiano-heredero-del-surrealismo/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[Forbes]] Mexico}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Ferrier |first=Romain |title=Le «grattage», un mot français qui s’exporte à travers le monde |url=https://www.lefigaro.fr/langue-francaise/actu-des-mots/le-grattage-un-mot-francais-qui-s-exporte-a-travers-le-monde-20260311 |access-date=11 March 2026 |website=[[Le Figaro]]}}</ref>

Following his studies, he taught painting and art history in [[Rome]].<ref name=":6" />
[[File:Apotheosis, grattage su tela, opera dell'artista Giovanni Guida.jpg|thumb|''Apotheosis'', grattage - oil on canvas by Giovanni Guida, 2014.|left]]
In 2016–2017, his icon {{lang|la|Caesarius Diaconus}} ([[Caesarius of Terracina]]) was exhibited in museums and cathedrals around the world including [[Kunstgewerbemuseum Berlin|Kunstgewerbemuseum]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Il giovane pittore Giovanni Guida con la tecnica del grattage svela la verità nascosta |url=https://www.famigliacristiana.it/articolo/il-giovane-pittore-giovanni-guida-.aspx |website=[[Famiglia Cristiana]]}}</ref> of [[Berlin]], [[Museu Frederic Marès]]<ref name=":3" /> in Barcelona; [[Terra Sancta Museum]] Jerusalem; Lisbon's [[Igreja de São Roque|Museu de São Roque]];<ref name=":5" /> [[Manila Cathedral|Cathedral of Manila]]<ref name=":7">{{Cite web |last=Aranda |first=Hyacinth |title=Giovanni Guida turns grattage into a language of light and matter |url=https://vogue.ph/lifestyle/art/100-years-of-grattage-giovanni-guida/ |access-date=11 September 2026 |website=[[Vogue (magazine)]]}}</ref> (by Cardinal [[Luis Antonio Tagle|Luis Antonio Gokim Tagle]],<ref>{{Cite web |last=Severo |first=Jan Milo |title=Italian artist Giovanni Guida reminisces time in Manila |url=https://www.philstar.com/lifestyle/arts-and-culture/2025/04/18/2436254/italian-artist-giovanni-guida-reminisces-time-manila |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[The Philippine Star]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Zulueta |first=Lito B. |title=Icon and 'papabile': Tagle, St. Caesarius, and the Holy Spirit's descent on Manila |url=https://plus.inquirer.net/lifestyle/icon-and-papabile-tagle-st-caesarius-and-the-holy-spirits-descent-on-manila/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |newspaper=[[Philippine Daily Inquirer]]}}</ref> Pro-Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization); [[Essen Minster]]; and [[Glastonbury Abbey]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 May 2024 |title=Giovanni Guida, le jeune peintre italien qui fait dialoguer l'art avec la foi |url=https://www.lepelerin.com/religions-et-spiritualites/lactualite-de-leglise/giovanni-guida-le-jeune-peintre-italien-qui-fait-dialoguer-l-art-avec-la-foi-9486 |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[Le Pèlerin]]}}</ref>

== Works ==
'''Style and technique'''

His paintings are distinguished by the depth of [[Lapis lazuli|lapis lazuli blue]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Baral |first=Maitree |title=One hundred years of grattage: Giovanni Guida is creating what Ernst could never have imagined |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/life-style/the-arts/one-hundred-years-of-grattage-giovanni-guida-is-creating-what-ernst-could-never-have-imagined/articleshow/131442412.cms |access-date=1 June 2026 |website=[[The Times of India]]}}</ref>, [[silver]] and [[gold]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=KLEIN LEICHMAN |first=ABIGAIL |title=Italian Artist Giovanni Guida as high priest: Rome-based painter traces methodology to Jerusalem |url=https://www.jpost.com/international/article-837841 |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[The Jerusalem Post]] |date=18 January 2025 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Soto |first=Ángel |title=Giovanni Guida: un viaje espiritual a través del arte del 'grattage' |url=https://www.milenio.com/cultura/laberinto/giovanni-guida-viaje-espiritual-arte-grattage |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[Milenio]] |date=25 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=ARRIETA |first=JOSÉ |title=Vincula espiritualidad y surrealismo con el arte. Considerado una de las jóvenes promesas de la pintura italiana, Giovanni Guida retoma una técnica creada por Max Ernst para narrar su encuentro espiritual. |url=https://heraldodemexico.com.mx/cultura/2024/9/14/vincula-espiritualidad-surrealismo-con-el-arte-637698.html |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[El Heraldo de México]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Esparza |first=Daniel |title=Giovanni Guida: "All true art is already sacred" |url=https://aleteia.org/2023/09/20/giovanni-guida-all-true-art-is-already-sacred/ |website=[[Aleteia]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Latorre de Silva |first=Matilde |title=El pintor que rasga sus obras en busca de la verdad: «El color se hace arte a través de la unión de cielo y tierra» |url=https://www.eldebate.com/religion/catolicos/20240201/pintor-rasga-obras-busca-verdad-color-hace-arte-traves-union-cielo-tierra_171200.html |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[El Debate (Spain)]] |date=February 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Rodríguez |first=Juan Carlos |title=Giovanni Guida, diácono de luz en la oscuridad del mundo |url=https://www.vidanuevadigital.com/2026/07/25/giovanni-guida-diacono-luz-oscuridad-mundo/ |website=Vida Nueva}}</ref>
[[File:Etherea, who Wants To Live Forever, grattage su tela, opera dell'artista Giovanni Guida.jpg|thumb|270x270px|''Etherea'', oil on canvas by Giovanni Guida, 2021]]
He works particularly with [[grattage]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gúzman García |first=Laura Daniela |title=Giovanni Guida: “El arte tiene el deber de custodiar la incertidumbre”. El artista italiano reflexiona sobre el grattage, la memoria, la espiritualidad y el papel del arte en la era digital. |url=https://www.eltiempo.com/cultura/arte-y-teatro/giovanni-guida-el-arte-tiene-el-deber-de-custodiar-la-incertidumbre-3564565 |archive-url= |access-date=16 June 2026 |website=[[El Tiempo (Colombia)]]}}</ref>, a technique that involves scraping wet paint from the surface, and [[Rubbing (art)|frottage]].<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=Inocencio |first=Syrah Vivien |title=Scratching the surface: how Giovanni Guida uses century-old grattage technique to expose the sacred and the unseen |url=https://www.tatlerasia.com/lifestyle/arts/grattage-art-giovanni-guida |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[Tatler]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Il giovane pittore Giovanni Guida con la tecnica del grattage svela la verità nascosta |url=https://www.famigliacristiana.it/articolo/il-giovane-pittore-giovanni-guida-.aspx |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[Famiglia Cristiana]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Martínez-Bordiú |first=Almudena |title=Pintor católico utiliza esta curiosa técnica que evoca el "velo rasgado" del templo de Jerusalén |url=https://www.aciprensa.com/noticias/104159/artista-catolico-utiliza-tecnica-que-evoca-rasgadura-del-templo-de-jerusalen |website=[[Catholic News Agency]]}}</ref> To create these effects, Guida experiments with a variety of tools, including sponges, styluses, scalpels, steel brushes, and small metal blocks.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Gigena |first=Daniel |title=Giovanni Guida, el pintor napolitano fanático de Maradona que recrea el celeste de la bandera argentina. Tiene 30 años y ya figura en enciclopedias de arte contemporáneo; se lo considera "heredero de Max Ernst" por su técnica surrealista y es la joven revelación de Italia |url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/cultura/giovanni-guida-el-pintor-napolitano-fanatico-de-maradona-que-recrea-el-celeste-de-la-bandera-nid24112023/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[La Nación]] |date=24 November 2023 }}</ref><ref name=":6">{{Cite magazine |last=Coviello |first=Monica |title=Giovanni Guida, 30 anni, il più giovane italiano nelle enciclopedie d'arte internazionali |url=https://www.vanityfair.it/article/giovanni-guida-30-piu-giovane-italiano-enciclopedie-arte-internazionali |access-date=19 September 2025 |magazine=[[Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Giovanni Guida, el gran regreso del 'grattage' en el centenario del surrealismo |url=https://www.semana.com/cultura/articulo/giovanni-guida-el-gran-regreso-del-grattage-en-el-centenario-del-surrealismo/202428/ |website=[[Semana]] |date=21 August 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Franza |first=Francesco |title="Grattage" e "Frottage" nelle nuove ricerche, la giovane arte di Giovanni Guida guarda a Max Ernst |url=https://www.ilgiornale.it/news/arte/grattage-e-frottage-nelle-nuove-ricerche-giovane-arte-2102509.html#google_vignette |website=[[Il Giornale]] |date=7 January 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Minucci |first=Emanuela |title=È il grande momento del "grattage": il pugile di Basquiat all'asta per 35 milioni di dollari. Valutazione record da Christie's per «Sugar Ray Robinson», mentre a Milano la mostra su «Max Ernst» attrae centinaia di visitatori e un giovane italiano, Giovanni Guida, seguace di uno dei padri del surrealismo, entra nelle enciclopedie del mondo |url=https://www.lastampa.it/cultura/2022/10/25/news/e_il_grande_momento_del_grattage_il_pugile_di_basquiat_allasta_per_35_milioni_di_dollari-12198325/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=[[La Stampa]] |date=25 October 2022 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Cordero |first=Nicolás |date=25 May 2026 |title=Giovanni Guida, considerado el 'sucesor de Remedios Varo', es el italiano que está renovando el grattage |url=https://www.quien.com/cultura/2026/04/22/giovanni-guida-considerado-el-sucesor-de-remedios-varo-es-el-italiano-que-esta-renovando-el-grattage |website=Quién}}</ref> His grattage technique involves the progressive sealing of successive pictorial layers<ref name=":7" /> with specific [[resin]]s, in order to preserve their chromatic brilliance.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Giovanni Guida, biography and works |url=https://www.arte.it/artista/giovanni-guida-619 |access-date=19 September 2025 |website=Arte.it}}</ref>

'''Melanie Maria Felber''' (born 14 February 1991) is a Danish/Swiss [[handball player]] for the [[Switzerland women's national handball team|Switzerland national team]].

== Career ==
Felber was born in Switzerland and grew up in Denmark.<ref name=skara>{{cite web|url=https://www.sverigesradio.se/artikel/6965691 |publisher=sverigesradio.se|title=Ny spelare till Skara HF|access-date=21 September 2025|language=sv}}</ref> She played for Danish team [[Silkeborg-Voel KFUM]] until 2013,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.midtjyllandsavis.dk/artikel/7ebadb1d-5eca-4d95-a732-1da0e94d523d/ |publisher=midtjyllandsavis.dk|title=Ny stærk fløj til Silkeborg-Voel|access-date=6 December 2025|language=da}}</ref> when she joined the Norwegian team [[Halden HK]]. In 2016 she joined league rivals [[Fredrikstad BK]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fredrikstadbk.no/2016/09/02/vi-presenterer-arets-spillere-melanie-felber/ |website=fredrikstadbk.no|title=Vi presenterer årets spillere, Melanie Felber!|access-date=21 September 2025|language=no}}</ref> In 2018 she joined Swedish team [[Skara HF]].<ref name="skara" /> There, she won the [[Handbollsligan (women)|Swedish Championship]] in 2025, which was the first in club history.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.skarahf.se/news/7874404/SM-guldet-ar-Skaras |publisher=skarahf.se|title=SM-guldet är Skaras!|access-date=21 September 2025|language=sv}}</ref>

She represented Switzerland at the [[2025 World Women's Handball Championship]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Schweizer Frauen-Nationalteam startet in Schaffhausen in die finale WM-Vorbereitung - Handball Schweiz |url=https://www.handball.ch/de/news/2025/schweizer-frauen-nationalteam-startet-in-schaffhausen-in-die-finale-wm-vorbereitung/ |access-date=2025-11-05 |website=www.handball.ch |language=de}}</ref>

'''Maria Climent i Huguet''' ([[Amposta]], 9 January 1985) is a [[Catalonia|Catalan]] novelist, writer and translator. She holds a degree in [[Translation studies|Translation and Interpretation]] and has also studied [[Screenwriting]]. As well as novel-writing, her professional career has included language teaching, copywriting, social media and content management, and teaching [[creative writing]] workshops. Following her participation in a writing workshop with the cultural magazine Catorze, in 2016 she began publishing articles for the magazine on a regular basis.<ref>{{cite news |title=Surtdecasa: interview with Maria Climent (Catalan) |url=https://surtdecasa.cat/ebre/llibres/entrevista-maria-climent |date=2018}}</ref>

Her first [[Catalan language]] novel, ''Gina'' (L'Altra Editorial),<ref>{{cite news |title=Gina, L'Altra Editorial |url=https://www.laltraeditorial.cat/llibre/gina/ |date=2019}}</ref> was published in 2019. It narrates, with humour and tenderness, the difficulties faced by the protagonist Gina after she is diagnosed with [[multiple sclerosis]],<ref>{{cite news |last1=Europapress |title=La escritora Maria Climent novela en 'Gina' las dificultades de la esclerosis múltiple "con humor y sin frivolidad" |url=https://www.europapress.es/cultura/libros-00132/noticia-escritora-maria-climent-novela-gina-dificultades-esclerosis-multiple-humor-frivolidad-20191028184416.html |date=2019}}</ref> a disease which Maria also suffers from.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Zaera |first1=Anna |title=Maria Climent: “Merda, el moment és ara! |url=https://surtdecasa.cat/ebre/llibres/entrevista-maria-climent |agency=Surtdecasa |date=2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title='Gina', de Maria Climent, entre la malaltia i la maternitat |url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/encatala/20191201/471995866116/maria-climent-gina-literatura-catalana.html |agency=La Vanguardia |date=2019}}</ref> With Gina, Maria won the ''Premi Amposta Award'' in 2019<ref>{{cite web |title=Maria Climent, Premi Amposta 2019 |url=https://www.amposta.cat/pagina/ca/maria-climent-premi-amposta-2019#:~:text=L%E2%80%99escriptora%20ampostina%20Maria%20Climent%2C%20que%20a%20l%E2%80%99octubre%20del,ha%20estat%20reconeguda%20amb%20el%20Premi%20Amposta%202019. |website=Ajuntament d'Amposta }}</ref> and the literary prize ''El Setè Cel'' ([[Salt, Spain|Salt]]) in October 2020.<ref>{{cite news |title=Maria Climent guanya el premi Setè Cel 2020 de Salt amb la novel·la Gina |url=https://www.infosalt.cat/2020/10/28/maria-climent-guanya-el-premi-sete-cel-2020-de-salt-amb-la-novella-gina/ |agency=Info Salt |date=2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201101021718/https:/www.infosalt.cat/2020/10/28/maria-climent-guanya-el-premi-sete-cel-2020-de-salt-amb-la-novella-gina/ |archive-date=2020-11-01}}</ref> The [[Alfaguara]] publishing house published a Spanish translation of the novel in 2019.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Penguin Libros |title=Gina |url=https://www.penguinlibros.com/es/literatura-contemporanea/7109-libro-gina-9788420438993 }}</ref> It was published in French in 2023 ([[Éditions des Femmes]]),<ref>{{cite web |title=Maria Climent Huguet [French] |url=https://www.desfemmes.fr/auteur/maria-climent-huguet/ |website=Des Femmes |access-date=12 December 2025}}</ref> Ukrainian in 2024 (Bogdan),<ref>{{cite web |title=Maria Climent [Ukrainian] |url=https://bohdan-books.com/catalog/book/278506/ |website=Bohdan Books |access-date=12 December 2025}}</ref> Danish in 2025 (Aurora Boreal)<ref>{{cite web |title=Maria Climent [Danish] |url=https://auroraboreal.dk/tienda/c-romaner/gina-en-kvinde-diagnosticeret-med-sklerose/ |website=Aurora Boreal books |access-date=12 December 2025}}</ref> and Greek in 2025 by World Books publishing house.<ref>{{cite web |title=Maria Climent [Greek] |url=https://www.worldbooks.gr/product/gina/ |website=World Books |access-date=12 December 2025}}</ref>

Also in 2019, Maria translated the young adults novel [[Aristotle and Dante Discover the Secrets of the Universe]] by  [[Benjamin Alire Sáenz]] (2012) into Catalan with L’Altra Tribu publishers.

In 2023, Maria published her second novel, ''A Casa Teníem Un Himne'' (''At home we had an anthem'') with the L'Altra Editorial publishers.<ref>{{cite news |title=A casa teníem un himne |url=https://www.catorze.cat/lectura/tast-editorial-sorteig/a-casa-teniem-un-himne_1209818_102.html |access-date=12 December 2025 |agency=Catorze |date=2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=A Casa Teníem Un Himne [English reviews/summary] |url=https://www.agenciabalcells.com/en/authors/works/maria-climent/a-casa-teniem-un-himne/ |website=Agencia Literaria Carmen Balcells |access-date=14 December 2025}}</ref> Dealing with family secrets and the challenges and tragedies of life faced by two daughters and their mother, the book was a finalist for the prestigious ''Premi Omnium Best Novel 2023'' award. A Spanish translation was published in 2024 by Grijalbo, a French translation in 2025 by [[Éditions des Femmes]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Maria Climent Huguet [French] |url=https://www.desfemmes.fr/auteur/maria-climent-huguet/ |website=Des Femmes |access-date=12 December 2025}}</ref> and a Brazilian Portuguese translation in 2025 by Olinda/Ímã Editorial.<ref>{{cite web |title=Translations of Maria Climent's novels |url=https://www.llull.cat/english/literatura/trac_traduccions_res.cfm?AUTOR=maria+climent&TITOL=&EDITORIAL=&ANY_MIN=&ANY_MAX=&ISBN=&GENERE=&LIJ=&LLENGUA=&PAIS=&sa2=Search |website=Institut Ramon Llull |access-date=14 December 2025}}</ref> It has also recently been translated into Croatian.

In 2023 a short story by Maria was included in the collection of [[noir fiction]] written by modern Catalan female authors, ''Elles També Negregen'' (''Women also write noir fiction'') which was coordinated by Irene Solanich Sanglas.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Nuvol |title=Elles també negregen |url=https://www.nuvol.com/llibres/elles-tambe-negregen-339177 |date=2023}}</ref>

In 2024 Maria published her first non-fiction book with the Ara Llibres publishing house. Based on her own experience, ''Mai És Una Paraula Molt Lletja'' (''Never is a very ugly word'') deals with the subject of [[infertility]] and [[Assisted reproductive technology|assisted reproductive treatments]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Marfanta |title='Mai és una paraula molt lletja', una història real sobre la infertilitat i el llarg procés per ser mare |url=https://www.marfanta.com/2024/02/29/maria-climent-publica-mai-es-una-paraula-molt-lletja/ |access-date=12 December 2025 |agency=ACN |date=2024}}</ref> Maria combines reflections on her own struggles to become a mother with facts, statistics and medical information about the different treatments available.

As of 2025, none of her books have been translated into English.

'''Ronal Omar Huaccha Jurado''' (born on 20 December 1993) is a Peruvian professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as [[Forward (Association football)|forward]] for [[Sport Huancayo]], a [[Liga 1 (Peru)|Liga 1]] club.

== Playing career ==
Having come through the ranks at [[Unión Comercio]] and after a stint with [[Comerciantes Unidos]], Ronal Huaccha made a name for himself in 2019 as the top scorer in the [[Liga 2 (Peru)|2nd division championship]] with [[Atlético Grau]].<ref name="America TV">{{Cite web|title=Sport Huancayo le quitó a Atlético Grau al goleador de la Liga 2, Ronal Huaccha|trans-title=Sport Huancayo snatched Ronal Huaccha, the top scorer in Liga 2, from Atlético Grau|url=https://www.americatv.com.pe/deportes/futbol-peruano/sport-huancayo-le-quito-atletico-grau-al-goleador-liga-2-ronal-huaccha-n397624|website=[[América Televisión|América TV]]|language=es|date=20 December 2019|access-date=15 December 2025}}</ref> That same year, he won the [[Copa Bicentenario]] with the same club.<ref name="el Popular">{{Cite web|title=Ronald Huaccha: “Creo que en Grau no me valoraron”|trans-title=Ronald Huaccha: “I don’t think they valued me at Grau”|url=https://elpopular.pe/deportes/258331-ronald-huaccha-creo-grau-valoraron-sport-huancayo-atletico-grau-union-comercio-wilmar-valencia|website=el Popular|language=es|date=21 December 2019|access-date=15 December 2025}}</ref> In 2020, he signed for [[Sport Huancayo]], the club where he still plays.

'''Mariona Martínez Terés''' (born 26 April 1985) is a Spanish actress.

== Life and career ==
Mariona Martínez Terés was born on 26 April 1985 in [[Barcelona]].<ref name="bluper">{{Cite web|website=Bluper|via=[[El Español]]|first=Mike|last=Medianoche|url=https://www.elespanol.com/corazon/bluper/20240626/mariona-teres-actriz-acude-pasapalabra-invitada-semana/865913901_0.html|title=Quién es Mariona Terés, la actriz que acude a ‘Pasapalabra’ como invitada esta semana|date=26 June 2024}}</ref><ref name="sport">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/actualidad/mariona-teres-nueva-invitada-pasapalabra-116737580|website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]]|publisher=[[Prensa Ibérica]]|date=25 April 2025|title=Mariona Terés es la nueva invitada de Pasapalabra: todo sobre su trayectoria como actriz|first=Ramón|last=Gutiérrez}}</ref> She made her acting debut in television in the soap opera ''[[Acacias 38]]'', playing Enriqueta in 50 episodes.<ref name="marca">{{Cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/tiramillas/television/2025/04/25/mariona-teres-actriz-mitica-serie-tve-e-invitada-hoy-pasapalabra.html|website=Tiramillas|via=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|date=30 April 2025|first=Calíope|last=García|title=Quién es Mariona Terés, invitada hoy en 'Pasapalabra' y actriz de una mítica serie de TVE}}</ref>

She gained notoriety for playing a version of herself in the comedy series ''[[Paquita Salas]]''.<ref name="bluper" /><ref name="sport" /> She has retroactively considered the role a gift as despite already having agent, nobody had given her a chance before and was told by casting directors that she "did not fit in with what they wanted physically".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elmundo.es/como/2024/06/25/667accb2fc6c8379478b45a5.html|date=25 June 2024|title=Quién es Mariona Terés, la nueva invitada de Pasapalabra|website=[[El Mundo (Spain)|El Mundo]]}}</ref> Other television works include appearances in ''{{ill|Centro médico|es|Centro médico (serie de televisión de España)}}'', ''[[Cuerpo de élite]]'', ''[[Terror y feria]]'', ''[[Cuéntame cómo pasó]]'', ''[[Historias de Alcafrán]]'', ''[[Veneno (TV series)|Veneno]]'', ''[[One Way or Another (TV series)|One Way or Another]]'', ''[[Wrong Side of the Tracks (TV series)|Wrong Side of the Tracks]]'', ''{{ill|La pasión turca (TV series)|es|La pasión turca (serie de televisión)|lt=La pasión turca}}'', and ''[[Mariliendre]]''.<ref name="marca" /><ref name="bluper" /><ref name="sport" /> For her starring role as Leo in ''[[The Girls at the Back]]'', she earned a nomination for Best Television Actress in a Leading Role at the [[31st Actors and Actresses Union Awards]].<ref name="marca" /><ref>{{Cite web|website=[[Fotogramas]]|url=https://www.fotogramas.es/noticias-cine/a42718434/union-de-actores-2023-nominados-ganadores/|title=Premios Unión de Actores 2023: 'As bestas' y 'Cinco lobitos', las películas más premiadas|date=14 April 2023|first=María|last=Aller}}</ref>

Early film work include appearances in ''{{ill|Cuerpo de élite (film)|es|Cuerpo de élite (película)|lt=Cuerpo de élite}}'', ''La sexta alumna'', ''[[Holy Camp!]]'', ''{{ill|Hacerse mayor y otros problemas|es}}'', ''[[Mylove Lost]]'', anda ''Pijamas espaciales''.<ref>{{Cite web|website=Vanitatis|via=[[El Confidencial]]|title=Quién es Mariona Martínez Terés, la nueva invitada de Pasapalabra|date=27 June 2025|first=Claudia|last=Martínez|url=https://www.vanitatis.elconfidencial.com/famosos/2024-06-27/mariona-martinez-teres-invitada-pasapalabra_3912669/}}</ref>

In 2026, she starred as Esperanza Artigas in the comedy-drama television series ''[[Hope's Corner]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elmundo.es/television/series/2026/04/18/69e20449fdddffb5188b4570.html|website=[[El Mundo (Spain)|El Mundo]]|first=Borja R.|last=Catela|date=18 April 2026|title=La 'esperanza' de La 1 de volver a sentar a la familia frente a la televisión con una serie}}</ref>

'''Sarah Blizzard''' (born 19 October 1996) is an Australian [[Bobsleigh|bobsledder]]. She represented Australia at the [[2026 Winter Olympics]].

==Career==
Blizzard grew up in [[Ararat, Victoria]].<ref name="AusProf">{{cite web |url=https://www.olympics.com.au/olympians/sarah-blizzard/ |title=Sarah Blizzard |website=Olympics.com.au |publisher=[[Australian Olympic Committee]] |accessdate=28 February 2026}}</ref> She began her sport career as a [[track and field]] athlete, specializing as a sprinter. She made the finals of the [[Stawell Gift]] in four consecutive years.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://stawellgift.com/wp/2022/02/sarah-blizzards-2022-beijing-winter-olympics-grit/ |title=Sarah Blizzard’s 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics grit |website=stawellgift.com |publisher=Stawell Athletic club |date=10 February 2022 |accessdate=28 February 2026}}</ref>

In 2019, she was recruited to bobsleigh to be the brakewoman for [[Breeana Walker]]'s team, and made her competitive debut in late 2019.<ref>{{cite web |last=Bone |first=Alyssa |date=9 January 2026 |url=https://www.nine.com.au/sport/olympics/milano-cortina-2026-australia-sarah-blizzard-living-out-bobsleigh-cool-runnings-moment-exclusive-20260110-p5nt02.html |title=From the Stawell Gift to Milan, Australia's Sarah Blizzard is living out her Cool Runnings dream |website=Nine.com.au |publisher=[[Nine Entertainment]] |accessdate=28 February 2026}}</ref> She was named as the reserve injury-substitute brakewoman for Australia's team at the [[2022 Winter Olympics]], but was not called up to participate.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.olympics.com.au/news/alternate-universe-how-sarah-blizzard-turned-heartbreak-into-leadership/ |title=Alternate universe: How Sarah Blizzard turned heartbreak into leadership |website=Olympics.com.au |publisher=Australian Olympic Committee |accessdate=28 February 2026}}</ref>

Beginning in 2023, Blizzard transitioned to being a pilot instead of a brakewoman. During the 2023–24 season, Blizzard earned multiple podium finishes in the Europe Cup, marking her first bobsleigh podiums.<ref name="AusProf" /> She began competing regularly in the World Cup the following season. During the 2025–26 season, she finished with enough qualification points to qualify for the [[2026 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="AusProf" /> She competed in the two-woman competition, where she finished 21st.<ref name=OlympicProf />

Prior to the 2026 Olympics, Blizzard was commended for her sportsmanship after she loaned her two-person bobsleigh to the Dutch men's team of [[Dave Wesselink]] to assist them in qualifying for the Olympics. Wesselink's team successfully qualified using Blizzard's sled, and were present in the men's two-man competition during the Olympic games.<ref>{{cite web |last=Smale |first=Simon |date=16 January 2026 |url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-01-17/sarah-blizzard-bobsled-dutch-team-lend-sleigh-winter-olympics/106236422 |title=Sarah Blizzard's stunning sportsmanship helps Dutch bobsledders achieve Winter Olympics dream |website=ABC.net.au |publisher=[[Australian Broadcasting Corporation]] |accessdate=28 February 2026}}</ref>

'''Simone Daprà''' (born 19 June 1997) is an Italian cross-country skier who competes in international competitions including the FIS Cross-Country World Cup and the FIS Nordic World Ski Championships.<ref name="CONI">{{cite web |title=Simone DAPRÀ |url=https://milanocortina2026.coni.it/en/italia-team/team/scheda_atleta/1715:Simone_DAPRÀ.html |website=Milano Cortina 2026 – Italia Team |publisher=Italian National Olympic Committee (CONI) |access-date=9 March 2026 |quote=Date of birth: 19/06/1997, Place of Birth: Panchià}}</ref> He represents the Italian police sports group [[Gruppo Sportivo Fiamme Oro|Fiamme Oro]] and is a member of the Italian national cross-country skiing team.<ref name="CONI" /><ref name="Milano Cortina 2026">{{cite web |title=Simone DAPRA |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/results/athlete-details/22214 |work=[[Milano Cortina 2026 Olympics]] |access-date=9 March 2026 |quote=Date of Birth: 19 June 1997, Place of Birth: Cavalese |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260210134712/https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/results/athlete-details/22214 |archive-date=10 February 2026 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Daprà was born in [[Panchià]],<ref name="CONI" /> in the Val di Fiemme valley of [[Trentino]], [[Italy]], an area known for cross-country skiing competitions and training facilities.His family has a strong connection with the sport, and he grew up in a region that regularly hosts major international Nordic skiing events.<ref name=":1" />

== Career ==
Daprà competes internationally as part of the Italian national cross-country skiing team and has participated in [[FIS Cross-Country World Cup]] events and world championship competitions.<ref name=":2" />

He represented Italy at the [[2025 FIS Nordic World Ski Championships]] in [[Trondheim]], where he achieved a 21st-place finish in the skiathlon, his best individual result at a world championship at the time.<ref name=":3" />

At the same championships, Daprà also competed in the men's 50 km race and finished 29th, describing the race conditions as among the most difficult he had experienced.<ref name=":3" />

Daprà has also been part of the Italian men's relay team in international competitions. Italy finished sixth in the men's relay at the 2025 World Championships in [[Trondheim]],<ref name=":7"/> a result achieved by a team that included several members of the Italian national squad.<ref name=":4" /><ref name=":7" />

For the 2025–26 season, he was named to Italy's senior A-team for cross-country skiing by the Italian Winter Sports Federation (FISI).<ref name=":2" />

He has also competed in national competitions in [[Italy]], including the Italian relay championships, where teams including Daprà have finished on the podium.<ref name=":5" />

== Personal life ==
Outside of competition, Daprà enjoys outdoor activities such as fishing and mushroom picking.<ref name=":6" />

'''Michael James Provost''' (born January 24, 1998) is an American actor. He is best known for his roles in ''[[Insatiable (TV series)|Insatiable]]'' and ''[[9-1-1: Nashville]]''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Michael Provost — In Reflection: A Conversation with Michael Provost |publisher=l’Odet |work=l-odet.com |url=https://www.l-odet.com/features/michael-provost |access-date=2026-03-16}}</ref><ref name="Cast">{{Cite web|last=Cordero|first=Rosy|date=June 3, 2025|title=''Raising Kanan''{{'s}} Hailey Kilgore & ''Harlem''{{'s}} Juani Feliz Among 4 Cast As Series Regulars In ''9-1-1: Nashville''|url=https://deadline.com/2025/06/9-1-1-nashville-hailey-kilgore-juani-feliz-cast-1236421918/|access-date=August 13, 2025|website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Provost was born in [[Bridgeport, Connecticut]] and raised in [[Atlanta, Georgia]]. He is of [[French Canadian]], [[Scottish people|Scottish]], and [[Irish people|Irish]] descent.<ref>{{cite web |title=IMDb: Michael Provost |publisher=IMDb.com |url=https://www.imdb.com/name/nm4413892/ |access-date=2026-03-16}}</ref>

Provost began his on-screen career in 2011 as Boyd in the American television family sitcom ''[[Reed Between the Lines]]'', appearing for one episode.<ref>{{cite web |title=Insatiable on Netflix: Who is Michael Provost? |publisher=Express.co.uk |work=Daily Express |date=2018-08-14 |url=https://www.express.co.uk/showbiz/tv-radio/1003357/insatiable-netflix-cast-who-is-actor-michael-provost-brick-armstrong-debby-ryan-plot |access-date=2026-03-16}}</ref> He also had small roles in the films ''[[An Innocent Kiss]]'', ''[[The Case for Christ]]'', and ''[[Reality High]]''. He gained prominence in 2018, starring as Brick Armstrong in the [[Netflix]] dark comedy series ''[[Insatiable (TV series)|Insatiable]]''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Michael Provost Is The Standout Star of Netflix's 'Insatiable' |publisher=Decider |work=Decider.com |date=2018-08-14 |url=https://decider.com/2018/08/14/michael-provost-brick-armstrong-insatiable/ |access-date=2026-03-16}}</ref> He also starred in the 2021 film ''[[Fear Street Part Two: 1978]]'' and appeared as a 'holdover' in the 2023 film ''[[The Holdovers]]''. '''Stephaun Bradford Branch'''<ref>{{cite web |title=Stephaun Bradford Branch — Born 1995, San Bernardino County, California |url=https://californiabirthindex.org/birth/stephaun_bradford_branch_born_1995_23481761 |website=CaliforniaBirthIndex.org |access-date=28 April 2026}}</ref> (born November 7, 1995) is an [[United States|American]] professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Bogor Hornbills]] of the [[Indonesian Basketball League]] (IBL). He previously played [[college basketball]] for [[Mt. San Antonio College]] and the [[West Georgia Wolves men's basketball|West Georgia Wolves]].

== College career ==

Branch began his college career at [[Mt. San Antonio College]] in [[Walnut, California]], where he spent two years before joining the Wolves of the [[West Georgia University]] of the [[NCAA Division II]] in 2015, where he played two seasons, averaging 16.4 points, 7.3 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.3 blocks per game. He was included in both seasons in the best team of the [[Gulf South Conference]].<ref>{{Cite web |author=West Georgia|date=21 September 2017 |title=2016-17 Men's Basketball Roster|url=https://uwgathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/steph-branch/3020|access-date=12 March 2026|website=uwgathletics.com |language=en}}</ref>

== Professional career ==

After going undrafted in the [[2017 NBA Draft]], Branch signed with the [[South Bay Lakers]] of the [[NBA G League]], where he played one season, averaging 10.6 points and 5.8 rebounds per game off the bench. At the start of the following season, he played in the NBA Summer League with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]], averaging 1.9 points and 1.8 rebounds in the nine games he played.<ref>{{Cite web |author=Shereen Rayan|date=21 September 2020 |title=South Bay Lakers: Getting to know a fierce Stephaun Branch|url=https://lakeshowlife.com/2017/12/05/south-bay-lakers-getting-know-fierce-stephaun-branch/|access-date=12 March 2026|website=lakeshowlife.com |language=en}}</ref>

In December 5, 2024 Branch joins the [[Tangerang Hawks]] of the [[Indonesian Basketball League]] (IBL).<ref>{{Cite web |author=IBL Indonesia|date=5 December 2024 |title=Tangerang Hawks Mendatangkan Stephaun Branch|url=https://iblindonesia.com/news/tangerang-hawks-mendatangkan-stephaun-branch|access-date=12 March 2026|website=iblindonesia.com |language=en}}</ref>

On December 25, 2025, Branch joins the [[Bogor Hornbills]] of the [[Indonesian Basketball League]]. At the Hawks, he averaged 20 PPG, 7,8 RPG, and 5,5 APG in 23 games played.<ref>{{Cite web |author=ANTATA|date=25 December 2025 |title=Stephaun Branch "nyeberang" dari Tangerang Hawks ke Bogor Hornbills|url=https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5324086/stephaun-branch-nyeberang-dari-tangerang-hawks-ke-bogor-hornbills|access-date=12 March 2026|website=antaranews.com |language=en}}</ref>
